sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

One of the key features of the game is its tile-sliding mechanic. Players can slide tiles horizontally or vertically, but not diagonally. This adds a level of complexity to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to ensure they reach their desired destination. The game also features a "hint" system, which provides players with a subtle nudge in the right direction when they're stuck. However, be careful not to rely too much on hints, as they can spoil the fun and challenge of the game.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Hippocampus Memory Match are engaging, challenging, and addictive. The game requires strategy, attention to detail, and a steady hand, making it a great fit for players of all ages and skill levels.
